Is your learner...

Consumed With The Idea of Becoming A YouTube Star...

But they lack the skills, discipline & executive functioning required to pull it off?

Welcome to the Raising A Wannabe YouTube Star FREE Email Course:

A straightforward and evidence-based way to help your learner master attainable goal-setting.

Sign Me Up!

do any of the following Phrases sound familiar?

"You don’t understand anything about social media.”


“It’s not that hard to get a few thousand followers.”


“If he can make a bunch of money, I KNOW I can make a bunch of money.”

According to a recent Pew Research Center survey, a whopping 85% of U.S. teens ages 13 to 17 use YouTube.


With more kids than ever before admiring viral social media influencers' lifestyles, the temptation to chase the dream of "making it big" has also grown.


What’s a 21st-century parent (or educator) supposed to do if you know this isn’t an attainable or appropriate goal for your teen?

This course will attempt to answer that very question.


Over the next several weeks, we’ll walk step-by-step through critical strategies to help your child develop clear and realistic goals.


And if it turns that working towards being a social media sensation is realistic after all, you'll have the peace of mind knowing that you and your teen came to that conclusion logically.

Sign Me Up!

As A Result of Taking Our Free Raising Wannabe YouTube Star Course...

You will learn:

  1. What to do when your teen’s goal and current skills are mismatched.
  2. How to help your child evaluate the executive functioning skills required to achieve their biggest goals.
  3. How executive functioning shortfalls might be underlying your teen's behavior.
  4. How to implement an evidence-based strategy with your teen to set more attainable goals.

To tie it all together, we'll be following a real-life case study example where we examine Casey's story, a 14-year-old wannabe YouTube star. We'll cover the process his parents and teachers followed to help him realize his own true potential.

5 Engaging Lessons Designed To Walk You Through The Process With Your Learner

All lessons include:

  • A clear learning target
  • Step-by-step action steps to implement with your learner
  • An evidence-based approach to backup
  • Supplemental materials (e.g. further reading links & PDF worksheets)
  • Real world case study examples
Sign Me Up!

1

Lesson 1 - Why Setting Unattainable Goals is a Problem

Estimated lesson time: 8 minutes

"Casey” – 14 year old chasing the “YouTube sensation” goal. Dropping off homework and other responsibilities to watch videos, saving up for expensive equipment, etc.

2

Lesson 2 - Things to Avoid When Goals & Skills are Mismatched

Estimated lesson time: 20-25 minutes

Casey’s parents are frustrated but don’t know what to do next. They seek the advice of an executive functioning coach/teacher at Casey’s school who will guide through some options.

3

Lesson 3 - Executive Functioning Part I

Estimated lesson time: 10-15 minutes

Casey’s teacher meets with his parents about the YouTube Sensation goal. Suggests that it’s not about the goal, but about Casey’s executive functioning skills. Teacher outlines for parents what executive functioning skills are and why they’re really at the core of the YouTube goal.

4

Lesson 4 - Executive Functioning Part II

Estimated lesson time: 20-25 minutes

Teacher gives parents some tools to evaluate Casey’s executive functioning skills. Parents meet with Casey to talk about the skills required to meet his big YouTube goal. Casey and his parents begin to agree on a smaller goal tied to executive functioning skills.

5

Lesson 5 - Intro to SMART Goals

Estimated lesson time: 10-15 minutes

Teacher, Casey & parents meet to talk about setting SMART goals. Agree to set a SMART goal for parents goals (for catching up on homework) and then a SMART goal for Casey (writing an outline of scripts).

Is your learner...

Consumed With The Idea of Becoming A YouTube Star...

But they lack the skills, discipline & executive functioning required to pull it off?

Welcome to the Raising A Wannabe YouTube Star FREE Email Course:

A straightforward and evidence-based way to help your learner master attainable goal-setting.

Sign Me Up!

do any of the following Phrases sound familiar?

"You don’t understand anything about social media.”


“It’s not that hard to get a few thousand followers.”


“If he can make a bunch of money, I KNOW I can make a bunch of money.”

According to a recent Pew Research Center survey, a whopping 85% of U.S. teens ages 13 to 17 use YouTube.


With more kids than ever before admiring viral social media influencers' lifestyles, the temptation to chase the dream of "making it big" has also grown.


What’s a 21st-century parent (or educator) supposed to do if you know this isn’t an attainable or appropriate goal for your teen?

This course will attempt to answer that very question.


Over the next several weeks, we’ll walk step-by-step through critical strategies to help your child develop clear and realistic goals.


And if it turns that working towards being a social media sensation is realistic after all, you'll have the peace of mind knowing that you and your teen came to that conclusion logically.

Sign Me Up!

As A Result of Taking Our Free Raising Wannabe YouTube Star Course...

You will learn:

  1. What to do when your teen’s goal and current skills are mismatched.
  2. How to help your child evaluate the executive functioning skills required to achieve their biggest goals.
  3. How executive functioning shortfalls might be underlying your teen's behavior.
  4. How to implement an evidence-based strategy with your teen to set more attainable goals.

To tie it all together, we'll be following a real-life case study example where we examine Casey's story, a 14-year-old wannabe YouTube star. We'll cover the process his parents and teachers followed to help him realize his own true potential.

5 Engaging Lessons Designed To Walk You Through The Process With Your Learner

All lessons include:

  • A clear learning target
  • Step-by-step action steps to implement with your learner
  • An evidence-based approach to backup
  • Supplemental materials (e.g. further reading links & PDF worksheets)
  • Real world case study examples
Sign Me Up!

1

Lesson 1 - Why Setting Unattainable Goals is a Problem

Estimated lesson time: 8 minutes

"Casey” – 14 year old chasing the “YouTube sensation” goal. Dropping off homework and other responsibilities to watch videos, saving up for expensive equipment, etc.

2

Lesson 2 - Things to Avoid When Goals & Skills are Mismatched

Estimated lesson time: 20-25 minutes

Casey’s parents are frustrated but don’t know what to do next. They seek the advice of an executive functioning coach/teacher at Casey’s school who will guide through some options.

3

Lesson 3 - Executive Functioning Part I

Estimated lesson time: 10-15 minutes

Casey’s teacher meets with his parents about the YouTube Sensation goal. Suggests that it’s not about the goal, but about Casey’s executive functioning skills. Teacher outlines for parents what executive functioning skills are and why they’re really at the core of the YouTube goal.

4

Lesson 4 - Executive Functioning Part II

Estimated lesson time: 20-25 minutes

Teacher gives parents some tools to evaluate Casey’s executive functioning skills. Parents meet with Casey to talk about the skills required to meet his big YouTube goal. Casey and his parents begin to agree on a smaller goal tied to executive functioning skills.

5

Lesson 5 - Intro to SMART Goals

Estimated lesson time: 10-15 minutes

Teacher, Casey & parents meet to talk about setting SMART goals. Agree to set a SMART goal for parents goals (for catching up on homework) and then a SMART goal for Casey (writing an outline of scripts).
